en-US.author: kurokeita
en-US.description: Rust crawler and EPUB builder for Vietnamese web novel sites
en-US.name: novel-downloader
en-US.releaseNotes:
novel-downloader v2.2.0, a feature release. EPUBs now carry a description and series metadata, and the interactive wizard gains a multi-line description editor. No breaking CLI changes from v2.1.0.
Highlights
- EPUB description. The wizard asks for a blurb in Crawl + EPUB and EPUB only modes and writes it as dc:description in the package. A blank answer omits the entry entirely, so a missing blurb stays invisible to readers and validators alike.
- Series metadata. Every book is declared a single-book series in the EPUB 3 collection form (belongs-to-collection with collection-type: series, group-position: 1), so Calibre and KOReader group it under its own name instead of leaving the series column empty. Confirmed clean by epubcheck under EPUB 3.3 rules.
- Multi-line description editor. A new TextArea prompt with a cursor over NFC-normalized text: one backspace removes one whole Vietnamese letter however the source spelled it. Arrow keys move by character and by wrapped row, Ctrl+J inserts a line break, Enter submits, Delete removes forward. The editor scrolls to keep the cursor on screen in short terminals.

Quality
- 428 tests passing
- cargo clippy --all-targets clean
- cargo fmt --check clean
- cargo build --release succeeds

Install
Homebrew:
brew tap kurokeita/brew
brew install novel-downloader
winget is not available for this release. Kurokeita.NovelDownloader has not yet been accepted into microsoft/winget-pkgs, so the publish job is frozen and no manifest exists to install from. Use Homebrew or the archives below.

Downloads
- Linux x86_64 (novel-downloader-linux-x86_64.tar.gz)
- Linux ARM64 (novel-downloader-linux-aarch64.tar.gz)
- macOS Intel (novel-downloader-macos-x86_64.tar.gz)
- macOS Apple Silicon (novel-downloader-macos-aarch64.tar.gz)
- Windows x86_64 (novel-downloader-windows-x86_64.zip)

What's changed since v2.1.0
- feat: add EPUB description and series metadata with a wizard description editor (#36)
- chore(release): v2.2.0 (#37)
